status: MEASURED: exact filled reference components and finite return witnesses; system qualification remains open

compact_DP_In1_join_plane_cut.scope: Actual source-to-candidate In1 ground removal intersected with the new DP join copper inflated by 0.200 mm. Overlapping antipads/donor changes prevent exclusive causal attribution.

method: Native KiCad polygons with 1 nm inside approximation. Full-width projection is area of actual trace/taper copper, not a centerline sample. A plane-component graph uses explicit .127 x .020 mm patches outside each .200 mm ground-via drill and inside its .450 mm annulus; no zero-area or zone-definition connectivity is inferred. Unproved reference components are retained in the report rather than treated as disconnected. U7/C28 ground-path overlaps are finite and all original geometry is independently invariant-checked.
qualification: Neither projection percentage nor nearest-via distance establishes return impedance. Mixed In2/In4 reference, DP In1 plane cut/coupling under connector DM, fabrication tolerance, USB impedance and common-mode behavior remain engineering gates. Existing 96 finite shield-spoke regions and U10/C18/C19 paths are separately reverified in this same candidate.
